summary: SENDBID re-test of 2 HIGH bugs (mobile viewport 390x844, demo client client@sendbid.app/Client@123!/PIN 123456). NOTE: Metro is running with CI=true (reloads disabled), so the source-file fixes were NOT initially picked up. After `sudo supervisorctl restart expo` the new bundle was served (verified by inspecting /node_modules/expo-router/entry.bundle for the new strings 'window.confirm' and `/transfer/auction?transfer_id=`). RESULT after restart: BUG #2 PASS, BUG #1 still FAIL (different root cause than originally suspected).

ui_bugs.issue: BUG #1 NOT FIXED. Tapping 'Voir les enchères' (testID success-continue) on /transfer/success still lands on /transfer/new (verified twice end-to-end after Metro restart, transfer_id e.g. 26843091-f966-49ba-a418-c2ed1a18addd). E1's fix changed `router.replace({pathname,params})` to `router.replace('/transfer/auction?transfer_id=...')` (string form) — bundle confirmed updated — but the navigation still ends on /new. ROOT CAUSE (different from previous RCA): recap.tsx performs a render-time redirect: `if (!draft) { router.replace('/transfer/new'); return null; }`. When success.tsx unmounts (cleanup `return () => clearDraft()` in its useEffect), zustand draft becomes null. recap.tsx is still mounted in the Expo Router Stack history → re-renders → finds no draft → fires router.replace('/transfer/new'). The React console warning 'Cannot update a component while rendering a different component' confirms this render-side setState/navigation anti-pattern. FIX OPTIONS: (a) Remove `return () => clearDraft()` from success.tsx useEffect (or call it AFTER router.replace fires), or (b) move the !draft redirect in recap.tsx into a useEffect (and gate render with a loading state).

react_native_issues.issue: Render-side `router.replace()` call triggers React warning 'Cannot update a component while rendering a different component' (logged in console). Should be moved into useEffect.

action_items: FIX HIGH (BUG #1 still open): in /app/frontend/app/transfer/success.tsx remove the cleanup `return () => clearDraft();` from the useEffect (or call clearDraft inside goNext AFTER router.replace). Alternatively, in /app/frontend/app/transfer/recap.tsx replace the render-time `if (!draft) { router.replace('/transfer/new'); return null; }` with a useEffect-based redirect plus a loading guard. Either change should stop the unwanted redirect to /transfer/new when the user taps 'Voir les enchères'.

INFRA: Metro is started with CI=true ('Metro is running in CI mode, reloads are disabled'). Future code changes will NOT be picked up by the running expo service unless `sudo supervisorctl restart expo` is run. Consider removing CI=true from the expo supervisor command so file edits are reflected without a restart.
INFO (BUG #2): no further action — fully verified after Metro restart.
OPTIONAL: address React warning 'Cannot update a component while rendering a different component' originating from recap.tsx (render-side router.replace).
critical_code_review_comments: Metro CI mode is the silent killer here: yarn start uses --tunnel via supervisor with CI=true env, which disables file watchers. Any time a fix is made to a .tsx file, an `sudo supervisorctl restart expo` is mandatory to see it served. Recommend documenting this in /app/README.md or removing CI=true.
Render-side navigation in recap.tsx (`if (!draft) router.replace('/transfer/new')`) is an anti-pattern. It causes the BUG #1 re-route AND emits a React warning. Fix: useEffect + loading state.

useEffect cleanup that mutates global state (clearDraft) on unmount is fragile when the same state is read by sibling/ancestor screens still in the navigation stack. Safer to clear inside the destination screen's mount effect, or after success render finishes.

success_rate.frontend: BUG #2 ✅ PASS, BUG #1 ❌ FAIL → 1/2 fixes effective

context_for_next_testing_agent: Two HIGH bugs were re-tested after fixes. BUG #2 (logout on web) is now FIXED — window.confirm fires, user is redirected to /welcome, /profile is gated post-logout. BUG #1 (success → auction routing) is STILL BROKEN even though E1's fix applied the string-URL form of router.replace. Real root cause is render-side `router.replace('/transfer/new')` inside /app/frontend/app/transfer/recap.tsx (lines 25-28) firing when success.tsx's useEffect cleanup nukes the zustand draft. CRITICAL operational note: Metro is started with CI=true (reloads disabled) — after editing any frontend file, run `sudo supervisorctl restart expo` and wait ~25s before re-testing. To verify fix is deployed, curl the bundle: `curl -s '<EXPO_BACKEND_URL>/node_modules/expo-router/entry.bundle?platform=web&dev=true&hot=false&lazy=true&transform.routerRoot=app' | grep -n '<expected new string>'`. Demo: client@sendbid.app / Client@123! / PIN 123456 / mobile viewport 390x844. Login uses testID login-identifier (not login-email).
rca_of_issue: BUG #1 reproduction (deterministic): login → /transfer/new → SN, 100 EUR, mode=cash, beneficiary, fee-2, purpose, source → next → confirm → PIN 123456 → /transfer/success?transfer_id=... → tap testID success-continue → URL becomes /transfer/new (Étape 1/4). The routing call in success.tsx IS now `router.replace(\`/transfer/auction?transfer_id=${t.id}\`)` (verified in served bundle line ~142881). Expo Router pushes the auction route, success.tsx unmounts → useEffect cleanup fires `clearDraft()`. recap.tsx, still mounted in the Stack history, re-renders synchronously and hits its render-side guard `if (!draft) { router.replace('/transfer/new'); return null; }`. That second router.replace wins and the user lands on /new. The React warning 'Cannot update a component while rendering a different component' in the console is exactly this anti-pattern. MITIGATION (any of): (1) remove the useEffect cleanup `return () => clearDraft()` in success.tsx; (2) call clearDraft() AFTER the navigation in goNext (e.g., setTimeout(clearDraft, 0)); (3) move the !draft redirect in recap.tsx into a useEffect with a loading state.
